title: Version 1.45.0
body:
Version 1.45.0 (🎅🏻 Christmas has arrived! 🎅🏻)

December 10th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Christmas decorations around the map
  • Added a brand new permanent snow biome
  • Added candy canes, christmas wreaths, stockings, and more to The Oak Depot!
  • Added 12 brand new limited time gifts. These gifts will be openable and disappear on Christmas!
  • Added brand new 'santa meteor' for a limited time
  • Added one seasonal tree, one permanent tree, and one permanent rock

Fixes:

  • Misc bug fixes
  • Fixed Emberbane disappearing

Version 1.45.1

December 11th, 2023

Added:

  • A few objects now have christmas hats!
  • Stockings now have the ability to put your name on them

Changed:

  • Snow is now always on the ground
  • Updated train translation string

Fixes:

  • Fixed tracks train being able to go off property

Version 1.45.2

December 11th, 2023

Added:

  • A Seasonal Menorah has appeared in the Oak Depot for purchasing!

Version 1.45.3

December 12th, 2023

Fixes:

  • The commander should now work with the '.' letter
  • Vials now work in vehicle beds
  • Slot names can now be changed on mobile
  • Neon vehicles now correctly show for the statistic tool
  • The interactor should no longer trigger on wires"
  • Flashlights/torches should now save their light state on rejoin

Version 1.45.4

December 13th, 2023

Fixed:

  • You should no longer get stuck on Initializing Save Slots!

Version 1.45.5

December 15th, 2023

Changes:

  • Vehicles no longer have a speed debuff when off roads
  • Vehicle trailer debuff speed has been changed from 0.85 -> 0.95.. a whole 10% more!

Fixes:

  • Chopped trees should now be able to correctly be picked up with the grabby grabber (hopefully)
  • The Oakmobile should be harder to flip over compared to before

Version 1.45.6

December 16th, 2023

Added:

  • Added number splitter, and number combiner components
  • Pressing B whilst in dialog will close the menu instantly
  • Schematics now display fill percentage when using stat tool
  • Added lacking stat tool details
  • Added ground below most lava locations
  • Controller users can now more accurately zoom their camera

Changes:

  • Rebalanced Festive Axe
  • Updated Gift Of Emotion hitbox
  • Removed classic shop meteor location
  • Small Corner Conveyor can no-longer scale down
  • Updated animations for the Grabbiest Grabber
  • The drawbridge is no longer a drawbridge, the NPCs will return in a new place in the future!

Fixes:

  • Festive Axe no-longer can one shot trees
  • Fixed cave regions overlapping with updated terrain from past update
  • Fixed various gaps and zfighting around the map
  • No more grabby grabber teleportation method at large distances :)
  • That rare occurrence where a player doesn't respawn should no longer happen

Version 1.45.7

January 5th, 2024

Changed:

  • Removed the christmas effects
